top.title: Starlink access still not fully restored for Ukraine’s military, says Zelenskyy
top.summary: Ukrainian president says US limiting access was a ‘dangerous and unpleasant surprise’, amid reports the order came from inside White House Europe live – latest updates Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said the Ukrainian military’s access to the Starlink satellite internet service has not yet been fully restored, as media reports suggested the order to throttle the service had come from within the White House. Zelenskyy met European leaders on Friday in Brussels, where he asked the EU for another €70bn…

articles.title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
articles.summary: Speed curbs limited Ukraine's defences against deadly Russian attacks on Tuesday night.

articles.title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House, sources say
articles.summary: The order to limit a satellite system used by Ukraine for battlefield communications and drone operations came from inside the White House.

articles.title: Order limiting Starlink access for Ukraine's military came from within White House, Reuters reports
articles.summary: Starlink, implemented speed restrictions on Oct. 14 without warning, limiting speed to 100 miles per hour (160 kilometers per hour). The unexpected restriction disrupted active military operations, including the use of mid-range strike and interceptor drones.
